Cape Town Mid-February Weather Snapshot, Cape Town, South Africa
Cape Town looks mostly pleasant across these five days, with   warm daytime temperatures (22–29°C)  ,   cooler evenings (16–19°C)  , and a brief wetter, windier spell in the middle.
-   Best overall beach/sightseeing weather:   12 Feb and 16 Feb
Best overall beach/sightseeing weather:   12 Feb and 16 Feb, Cape Town, South Africa
-   Most indoor-friendly day:   14 Feb
-   One mixed day to watch:   13 Feb, due to light rain and stronger wind
Best Days for Outdoor vs Indoor Plans
Day   Condition   Temp   Rain Chance   Wind   Travel Read
Thu 12 Feb   Sunny   27°C / 18°C   Low   19 kph   Excellent for a full outdoor day
Fri 13 Feb   Partly cloudy   24°C / 17°C   Light rain (2 mm)   28 kph   Fine for flexible plans; wind may affect coast viewpoints
Sat 14 Feb   Rain   22°C / 16°C   High (12 mm)   31 kph   Best kept for museums, shopping, or indoor dining
Sun 15 Feb   Clearing   25°C / 17°C   Low-light (1 mm)   22 kph   Good recovery day; decent for outdoor plans
Mon 16 Feb   Sunny   29°C / 19°C   Low   15 kph   Best full-day outdoor weather of the period
Top 2 for a full-day outdoor visit
-   12 Feb   — Sunny, warm, and not too windy; great for Table Mountain lower slopes, Kirstenbosch, Cape Point, or a city walking day.
-   16 Feb   — The warmest and calmest day in the forecast; strongest pick for beaches, scenic drives, and long outdoor sightseeing.
Best day for indoor activities
-   14 Feb   — Clear indoor day choice because of   steady rain and the strongest wind  .
- If you want a second indoor-leaning backup, choose   13 Feb  , since it is breezier with a chance of showers.
Traveler Comfort Guide
-   Pack for warm days:   light clothes, sunglasses, sunscreen, hat
-   Bring one extra layer:   evenings can feel cooler, especially near the coast
-   Wind matters in Cape Town:   even mild rain days can feel less comfortable at exposed spots like the waterfront, Chapman’s Peak, or Table Mountain
-   Most dependable sightseeing window:     12 Feb, 15 Feb, and especially 16 Feb
